say:0:1534406001:0.text: A finely crafted axe, carved from the highest-grade stone. Its edge gleams, polished to a razor finish.

say:1:1534406002:0.text: Compared to the tribe's crude weapons, this one is exquisite, its craftsmanship rivaling even the dwarves you've seen.
say:1:1534406002:0.source_cn: 相较于部落中那些原始粗犷的武器，这把斧子制作得格外精美...

say:4:1534406004:0.text: Careful! Watch your hands. This axe is dangerously sharp!
say:4:1534406004:0.source_cn: 小心手，这斧子锋利得很！
